title: Security identifiers
hints: Write the authority with a loop over shifts 40, 32, ... 0 (big-endian), and each sub-authority with shifts 0, 8, 16, 24 (little-endian). Reading is the same loops the other way.
For the text, split at `-` into parts after `S-1-`, then check each part's characters before converting: `std::from_chars` itself would accept a leading `-` or stop early, which the rules forbid.
